metadata.description: Claude plugins for freelance travel agents

plugins.name: travel-agent
plugins.description: Daily toolkit for freelance travel agents: FTA agent from request to priced quote (MinnieAI for Disney, FionaAI for Universal, Patty park plans), social content, destination research, client intake, trip folders, trip summaries, skills that learn from your feedback, an interactive dashboard of dates and pending tasks, and commission tracking.
